notes: REF-BM-02: resolveMetadata (src/core.js) only auto-fills title/desc for 6 hardcoded domains and never sets favicon or preview image — those fields don't exist anywhere in the data model. REF-BM-07: list rendering (app.js render()) shows title/desc/tags but no favicon. REF-BM-12: haystack() (core.js) indexes title/desc/note/source/hostOf(url) — only the hostname, not the full url path/query, so full-text-over-url is incomplete. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' token parsing in tokenize/itemMatches; tag filtering only via clicking a tag chip, not via search syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses grammar — itemMatches is a plain per-word substring AND. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling; tokenize just splits on whitespace. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select UI or bulk-action code anywhere in app.js. REF-BM-23: note field exists and is editable/searchable but rendered as plain contenteditable text, not parsed/rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot capture (local HTML/PDF) or Internet Archive integration code. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity (saved search+tag filter) anywhere in store.js/core.js. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export code. REF-BM-32: only sort preference is persisted (store.getSort/setSort); no displayed-items-count or font-size settings exist.
